title: Pricing Page
description: Reusable prop-driven pricing section: header (eyebrow + title + subtitle), responsive tiers grid (2/3/4 cols), and optional FAQ accordion. Built on shadcn primitives (Button, Card, Accordion). Featured tier supports ring/scale/tint visual variants. No Convex, no env — fully composed by templates via <PricingSection tiers={...} />.
